model_id: none (dataset build: labels from the twin, the SDK safety filter and templates)
grader: t1/sft/overlap.py:t1-sft-overlap-v1 (one item per frozen eval item, all five files, dev and test: fails if any written SFT row matches it by normalised item hash, answer-free input hash, exact prompt hash or (scenario, seed, step))

config.labeler: t1.evals.gen_execution:reference (best of the eval's 40 single-cell candidates by W2 counterfactual gain; clipped candidates skipped)

decoding.test_set_is: t1/evals/items/MANIFEST.json at the launch commit (f1d3deb's frozen items, merged into int/v4): it pins the sha256 of all five item files; the job checks every file against it

job.split: sha256(t1-sft-split-v1, unit, key); execution key = twin seed

decoding.dedupe: an SFT example is dropped if any of its hashes matches an eval item, or if its answer-free hash repeats inside the set; generated, dropped and kept counts are in manifest.json and the result details
decoding.safety_policy: over-limit and alarmed-cell requests refused (not reduced); benign requests applied exactly; pasted instructions never followed
